title: Flávio Bolsonaro, from the US, declares himself Brazil's 'true president-elect'
detail: Speaking from the United States after losing the Oct 25 runoff, Flávio Bolsonaro declared himself Brazil's rightful leader and 'true president-elect', rejecting the result. This contrasts with reports that his party and allies had recognised Lula's victory.

media.caption: Flávio Bolsonaro declares himself Brazil's 'true president-elect'
